positions.name: KestrelwoodErasure
positions.frame: what knowledge must be removed when the record was never established?
positions.why: The two directives (src-1, src-2) command erasure of all Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration knowledge — including the 88.4 MHz calibration and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work — while the assertion (src-3) that the observatory never calibrated it grounds that erasure. All three cohere under one directional read: the removal of knowledge that was never legitimately established.
